name: Campingplatz Tettenhausen
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Tettenhausen is located in Waging am See in the federal state of Tirol, Österreich. The surroundings are characterized by the Alpen with mountains and forests. In the surrounding area, hiking trails through the mountain world are marked. In the winter season, there are connections to ski areas in the region. The campsite has pitches with electricity connection and sanitary building. A disposal station for motorhomes is available. Guests use the site as a starting point for activities in nature.
